Hi Rob

A. Check the app is successfully connecting to your email providers server.

  1. Navigate to settings > account name > fetching mail > incoming server
  2. Click next

Does your account connect successfully or report an error?

B. Is the issue only with automatic sync? Do emails download when you press the sync account button?

C. Have you allowed the app to run in the background and excluded from battery optimisations in Android's settings.

D. Have you changed any settings on the fetching mail page.

E. Can you successfully send emails from the app?

F. Have you taken any steps to troubleshoot the issue, such as reinstalling and using default settings?

What version of Thunderbird for Android are you using?

Debug log capture is not crashing for me on v22.1 and 22.0b2 on Android 16. I've also not experienced the crash in prior versions i've used going back many years.

Given the crash, capturing the debug trace from Androids logcat using ADB is your best option. See method B in the guide linked below.

https://thunderbird.github.io/thunderbird-android/docs/latest/user-guide/troubleshooting/collecting-debug-logs.html
